title: Apple Q2 earnings preview: Surging stock price shows new role in AI trade
excerpt: The company has been able to weather a market storm as more AI-focused firms have struggled.
content_html:
Apple enters earnings in a new role: Wall Street's escape hatch from the AI trade

By Joe Ciolli

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Author of the First Trade newsletter

Tim Cook's final earnings report as Apple CEO is today after the closing bell. The exec — who has held the role since August 2011 — leaves his Apple post in a familiar position: a dominant force crushing the stock market.

Apple shares are up more than 2,400% since Cook took the reins, a period that's seen the tech giant add $4.6 trillion in market cap, becoming the world's first trillion-dollar company along the way.

Meanwhile, Apple is up 24% so far in 2026, trouncing the Magnificent 7 (flat) and S&P 500 (+7%). Much of that separation has come in the month of July, amid a reckoning of sorts for AI spending and the companies relying upon it.

The period of Mag 7 weakness has coincided with heightened sensitivity over exorbitant capex-spending plans and potential AI-demand slowdowns. Some areas, like the particularly vulnerable chipmaker sector, were plunged into bear markets.

Investors instead prioritized certainty: gigantic buybacks, strong cash flow, and pricing power — all attributes possessed by Apple. The shift is clear: Investors finally appreciate a company that doesn't need to explain a gigantic AI budget.

That all sets up an Apple earnings report that sees the company stepping into a new role, at least in the eyes of investors: an escape hatch from the AI trade.

Put differently, for much of the past two years, investors have favored whichever companies are most central to the AI-infrastructure buildout. In July, they started rewarding Apple because it isn't.

Despite Apple's new position as a shelter from AI jitters, its earnings are still a high-stakes affair for Big Tech and the broader stock market. Here's what investors will be looking for, as they get a respite from their capex-spending obsession:

1. Impact of the memory-chip squeeze

A global shortage has pushed memory-chip prices sharply higher this year, putting pressure on hardware margins. Apple has so far offset those costs with price hikes outside of the iPhone. Investors will be looking for clues about whether the company can continue protecting margins without raising iPhone prices.

2. iPhone demand

The iPhone remains Apple's biggest business, and Wall Street expects a sales jump thanks to the new iPhone 17 lineup. Investors will be watching for signs that the latest upgrade cycle still has momentum.

3. Can the China comeback continue?

China has gone from Apple's biggest headache to a bright spot for growth. Investors will want to see whether the recent rebound in the region is sustainable, especially amid fierce competition from Huawei and other local rivals.

content_html_zh:
苹果以新角色进入财报：华尔街从人工智能行业逃生

作者：Joe Ciolli 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。 第一贸易通讯作者

蒂姆·库克作为苹果首席执行官的最终收益报告将于今天收盘后发布。 这位自 2011 年 8 月起担任该职务的高管在离开苹果公司时处于一个熟悉的位置：压垮股市的主导力量。

自库克上任以来，苹果股价已上涨超过 2,400%，在此期间，这家科技巨头的市值增加了 4.6 万亿美元，成为世界上第一家价值数万亿美元的公司。

与此同时，截至 2026 年，苹果公司股价已上涨 24%，击败了 Magnificent 7 指数（持平）和标准普尔 500 指数（上涨 7%）。 大部分分离发生在 7 月份，当时正在对人工智能支出和依赖它的公司进行各种清算。

Mag 7 的疲软时期恰逢人们对过高的资本支出计划和潜在的人工智能需求放缓的敏感度提高。 一些领域，例如特别脆弱的芯片制造商行业，陷入了熊市。

相反，投资者优先考虑的是确定性：巨额回购、强劲的现金流和定价能力——所有这些都是苹果所拥有的属性。 这种转变很明显：投资者最终欣赏一家不需要解释巨额人工智能预算的公司。

这一切都为苹果公司的盈利报告奠定了基础，该公司将进入一个新角色，至少在投资者看来是这样：一个逃离人工智能行业的逃生舱。

换句话说，在过去两年的大部分时间里，投资者都青睐那些在人工智能基础设施建设中最核心的公司。 七月份，他们开始奖励苹果公司，因为事实并非如此。

尽管苹果公司已成为人工智能恐慌的庇护所，但其盈利对于大型科技公司和更广泛的股市来说仍然是一个高风险事件。 当投资者从资本支出的痴迷中得到喘息时，他们将寻求以下内容：

1. 内存芯片紧缩的影响

全球短缺导致今年内存芯片价格大幅上涨，给硬件利润率带来压力。 到目前为止，苹果已经通过 iPhone 以外产品的价格上涨来抵消这些成本。 投资者将寻找线索，了解该公司是否可以在不提高 iPhone 价格的情况下继续保护利润。

2. iPhone需求

iPhone 仍然是苹果最大的业务，华尔街预计，由于新款 iPhone 17 系列的推出，销量将出现大幅增长。 投资者将关注最新升级周期仍有动力的迹象。

3. 中国的复兴能否继续？

中国已经从苹果最头疼的地方变成了增长亮点。 投资者希望了解该地区近期的反弹能否持续，尤其是在华为和其他本土竞争对手的激烈竞争下。
